placeName.en: Olympic Valley to Auburn, California, USA

details.direction: Point-to-point from Olympic Valley to Placer High School in Auburn
details.distanceMethod: Official course pages give 100.2 miles; no metric distance is published. 100.2 miles converts to 161,256 m (161.3 km), which is the figure used on this card. No alternate official distance figure exists.
details.elevationMethod: Official Course Description gives 2,550 ft of climb in the first 4.5 miles plus another 15,540 ft, a summed total of 18,090 ft; the home page rounds this to more than 18,000 ft and the descent to nearly 23,000 ft. This card uses the exact summed climb, 18,090 ft = 5,514 m. The official pages do not publish per-segment gain or loss.
